title: Approximate tangent planes and unit orientations of subsets of a coordinate plane are ±e_ι
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, ι : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing, A ⊆ ℝ^P, x ∈ ℝ^P, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P, and ξ an n-vector (a continuous linear functional on n-covectors). Assume a_i = x_i for every a ∈ A and every i ∉ range ι. Assume also that Q is an approximate tangent space of A at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q, Simon Ch. 3, 1.4) and ξ is a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q). Then either ξ(α) = α(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(n−1)}) for every n-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(n−1)}) for every n-covector α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ι : Fin n → Fin P) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), StrictMono ι → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ i, (∀ j, ι j ≠ i) → a i = x i) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ))) ∨ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = -α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)))
